user.title: Connect to Dartec HA Manager
user.description: Enter the enrolment code from the Dartec admin panel for this home. A pairing token also works.

error.invalid_token: Unknown pairing token — generate an enrolment code in the Dartec admin panel.
error.invalid_code: Unknown enrolment code. Check it was typed correctly, or generate a new one in the Dartec admin panel.
error.code_expired: This enrolment code has expired. Generate a new one in the Dartec admin panel.
error.code_used: This enrolment code has already been used. Generate a new one in the Dartec admin panel.
error.code_revoked: This enrolment code was revoked. Generate a new one in the Dartec admin panel.
error.wrong_instance: This enrolment code is for a different home than the one this Home Assistant is paired to. Check the code, or remove the existing Dartec integration first.
error.rate_limited: Too many failed attempts from this network. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.enrolment_unsupported: This Dartec server does not accept enrolment codes. Use a pairing token instead.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Dartec server. Check the URL and internet connection.
error.insecure_url: The server URL must start with https:// — the pairing token is the key to this home and must not travel over an unencrypted connection.

abort.already_configured: This instance is already paired with Dartec HA Manager.
abort.repaired: This home was already paired. Its credential has been replaced with the new one and the integration reloaded.

init.title: Dartec HA Manager options
init.description: Both are off unless you turn them on here, and you can turn either off again at any time. Dartec cannot change them.

data.unattended_support: Allow Dartec support without the maintenance switch

data_description.unattended_support: Dartec may operate locks, covers, the alarm and restarts without someone switching 'Allow Dartec support' on first.
data_description.offsite_backups: Dartec may copy this home's backups, including its configuration and history, to Dartec's storage, on a schedule and with nobody at home. Deleting backups still needs the maintenance switch.

allow_maintenance.name: Dartec: allow maintenance
allow_maintenance.description: Let Dartec support perform sensitive operations (locks, covers, alarm, reboots, account changes) for a limited time. Everything done is logged.

minutes.name: Duration
minutes.description: How long the window stays open.
